description.value: A private campground tucked between the Quatse River and a 138-acre estuary wildlife sanctuary, just off Highway 19 and under a kilometre from BC Ferries — a tidy staging stop with showers, coin laundry, and Wi-Fi.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at porthardyrvresort.com is fully live and corroborates the OSM address. The /camping/ subpage explicitly confirms coin-operated laundry, showers, and free Wi-Fi on site, while OSM tags confirm drinking_water=yes and tents=yes. The /about-us/ page notes the resort is 'a short walk into Port Hardy' and 'close to all of the amenities,' supporting food nearby, and a dedicated Reservation page confirms bookings are accepted.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 1-250-949-8111 sourced from website only.
Website footer copyright year is 2019, suggesting the site may not be regularly updated, though content appears current and reservation functionality is active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented campground with tent sites, showers, coin laundry, and Wi-Fi situated less than a kilometre from the BC Ferries terminal at Port Hardy—a key waypoint for cyclists on the Vancouver Island route.

wow_evidence: coin-operated laundry, showers, and free Wi-Fi...less than a kilometre from the BC Ferries terminal at Port Hardy
